text: It depends on the zoo. Modern zoos that breed endangered species and teach children about conservation can do a lot of good — some animals only survive today because of them. But small zoos where animals live in tiny cages are a different story; they mainly exist to make money. So I'd keep the good ones and close those that can't meet proper standards.

tips.en: Some animals only survive today because of them is a strong fact in favour of zoos.
tips.kk: Some animals only survive today because of them — хайуанаттар паркінің пайдасына күшті дерек.
tips.ru: Some animals only survive today because of them — сильный факт в пользу зоопарков.
tips.example: some animals only survive today because of them

tips.en: I'd keep the good ones turns “it depends” into a clear opinion.
tips.kk: I'd keep the good ones — қорытынды «байланысты» дегенді нақты пікірге айналдырады.
tips.ru: I'd keep the good ones — вывод превращает «зависит» в чёткое мнение.

questions.question: Do zoos do more good than harm?

text: The most effective step is protecting their habitats, because most species disappear when their land is turned into farms or roads. Stricter punishments for poaching are important too. In Kazakhstan, the saiga population recovered partly because rangers started patrolling the steppe much more seriously. And international cooperation matters, since many animals migrate across borders and no single country can protect them alone.

tips.en: The most effective step is ranks the measures instead of just listing them.
tips.kk: The most effective step is … — шаралар жай тізіммен емес, маңыздылығы бойынша.
tips.ru: The most effective step is … — меры по важности, а не списком.
tips.example: The most effective step is protecting their habitats

tips.en: The saiga population recovered is a fact from your own country that supports the point.
tips.kk: The saiga population recovered — өз еліңізден алынған дерек ойды дәлелдейді.
tips.ru: The saiga population recovered — факт из своей страны подтверждает мысль.

questions.question: What can be done to protect endangered animals?

text: Mainly because cities keep expanding into areas that used to be forests and fields, so animals lose their natural territory. Cities also offer easy food — rubbish bins are full of leftovers. In some places that's charming, like foxes in London, but it can be risky with larger animals. I think towns need better planning, such as green corridors, so wildlife can move around safely.

tips.en: Cities keep expanding, so animals lose their natural territory: a chain in one sentence.
tips.kk: Cities keep expanding … so animals lose their natural territory — бір сөйлемдегі тізбек.
tips.ru: Cities keep expanding … so animals lose their natural territory — цепочка в одной фразе.

tips.en: Green corridors is a precise term that strengthens the answer.
tips.kk: Green corridors — дәл термин жауапты күшейтеді.
tips.ru: Green corridors — точный термин делает ответ сильнее.

questions.question: Why do wild animals increasingly appear in cities?

text: Generally, no. Animals like snakes, monkeys or big cats have very specific needs that most owners simply can't meet in a flat. Many of them are also taken from the wild illegally, which harms the species. And when owners get bored or the animal grows too big, it's often abandoned. So I'd only allow it with a special licence and regular checks.

tips.en: Needs, illegal capture and abandonment are three different reasons in turn.
tips.kk: Needs … taken from the wild illegally … abandoned — кезекпен үш түрлі себеп.
tips.ru: Needs … taken from the wild illegally … abandoned — три разные причины по очереди.
tips.example: Many of them are also taken from the wild illegally

tips.en: I'd only allow it with a special licence is a no, but not an absolute one.
tips.kk: I'd only allow it with a special licence — «жоқ», бірақ үзілді-кесілді емес.
tips.ru: I'd only allow it with a special licence — «нет», но не абсолютное.
tips.example: I'd only allow it with a special licence

questions.followUp: Which animals make the best pets?
questions.question: Should people be allowed to keep exotic animals as pets?

text: Yes, if it's managed properly. When tourists pay to see animals in national parks, local people have a reason to protect them rather than hunt them, because the animals bring in money. However, too many visitors can disturb animals and damage their habitat. That's why I think the number of tourists should be limited and part of the money should go directly to conservation.

tips.en: If it's managed properly is a yes with a condition in the first line.
tips.kk: If it's managed properly — бірінші сөйлемде шарты бар «иә».
tips.ru: If it's managed properly — «да» с условием в первой фразе.

tips.en: Limiting tourists and funding conservation make a two-part solution.
tips.kk: Limited … go directly to conservation — екі бөліктен тұратын шешім.
tips.ru: Limited … go directly to conservation — решение из двух частей.
tips.example: the number of tourists should be limited
